c1b3a40794093d41.description: About the Role IntercityHotel Riyadh is seeking an experienced and results-driven Hotel Reservation Manager to lead the reservations function. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, requires 3-5 years of experience and is crucial for maximizing room revenue and optimizing occupancy. The role involves managing distribution channels and ensuring an efficient reservation process for an international hotel brand under H World International. The salary range for this position is SAR 7,500 - SAR 11,250. Key Responsibilities Manage and supervise daily reservation operations, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and excellent guest service. Maximize room revenue through effective inventory management, pricing implementation, and reservation conversion. Monitor daily occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR), pickup, booking pace, cancellations, and no-shows. Manage room availability, restrictions, and rates across Opera PMS, Online Travel Agencies (OTAs), Global Distribution Systems (GDS), and other distribution channels. Ensure accurate implementation of corporate contracts, negotiated rates, group bookings, and promotional offers. Coordinate closely with Sales, Front Office, and Revenue Management to optimize business performance. Monitor OTA performance, booking trends, channel production, and reservation discrepancies. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reservation reports, forecasts, and business analysis. Handle group reservations, room blocks, special requests, and VIP bookings. Ensure proper handling of modifications, cancellations, deposits, and payment guarantees. Train, supervise, and evaluate reservation employees to maintain high productivity and service standards. Identify opportunities to increase direct bookings, reduce distribution costs, and improve overall profitability. Ensure compliance with hotel brand standards, reservation procedures, and company policies. Required Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of relevant experience in hotel reservations. Demonstrated commercial awareness and strong leadership skills. Hands-on experience with hotel reservation systems, online distribution platforms, and revenue management strategies. Work Environment and Conditions This is a full-time position with working hours and days determined by hotel operational requirements and Saudi labor regulations. The role is based at IntercityHotel Riyadh Malaz. Application Process Interested candidates with relevant hotel experience in Riyadh are encouraged to apply with an updated CV.

c1e79f9c9d87805b.description: نبحث عن مندوب مبيعات متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف النمو. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات، وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، وتحقيق الأهداف البيعية المحددة. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة، وقدرة على الإقناع، وشغف بالمبيعات، فهذه فرصتك لتطوير مسارك المهني. المهام الرئيسية: * تحديد العملاء المحتملين والتواصل معهم لعرض المنتجات والخدمات. * تقديم عروض تقديمية فعالة وشرح فوائد المنتجات للعملاء. * إتمام عمليات البيع ومتابعة رضا العملاء بعد الشراء. * تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الشهرية والربع سنوية. * المشاركة في تطوير خطط المبيعات التسويقية.

c106049fc4b5d552.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز التواصل الناجح لرعاية ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة عن أخصائي نفسي للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على فهم السلوك البشري والتفاعلات النفسية، مع المساهمة في إعداد التقارير المتخصصة وحفظها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء البحوث في أوجه النشاط النفسي المشتركة بين الأفراد والكشف عن القوانين والمبادئ التي تفسر سلوك الفرد وتفاعله مع المنبهات المحيطة. دراسة جميع مظاهر الحياة النفسية من خلال تحليل جوانب السلوك المختلفة مثل الجانب الحركي، العقلي، الانفعالي، والاجتماعي. دراسة مبادئ التعلم لحالات التعلم الإنساني وأشكاله المتعددة. تنفيذ دراسات ميدانية لتطبيق اختبارات الذكاء والأداء بهدف قياس أنماط النمو العقلي والنفسي. دراسة المبادئ والقوانين العامة لاستخلاص الأسس المميزة للسلوك الإنساني. تحليل وتطوير الاتجاهات والقيم الاجتماعية بناءً على المعلومات المستنبطة من المراقبة والمتابعة أو البحوث والتجارب الميدانية. دراسة وتطوير النظريات والاستخدامات التطبيقية في مجال تعديل السلوك. دراسة الأسس البيولوجية للسلوك من خلال التعرف على أجزاء الجهاز العصبي وأثرها في السلوك. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بعلم النفس، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال علم النفس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء البحوث والدراسات الميدانية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لفهم السلوك البشري وتفسيره. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في إعداد وكتابة التقارير المتخصصة. القدرة على عرض المعلومات وتوضيحها بشكل فعال. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في حفظ البيانات والوثائق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الأخصائي النفسي ضمن فريق متخصص في مركز التواصل الناجح لرعاية ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

c165b4977204f875.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. وضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشروعات. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. التأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. فهم جيد لعمليات تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل في بيئة تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: الرياض. الراتب: غير معلن.

c1699616ffe30b2a.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer with a minimum of 7 years of professional experience to oversee, design, develop, and implement electrical systems for construction, industrial, or infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will ensure compliance with technical specifications, safety standards, project schedules, and quality requirements. Key Responsibilities Design, review, and supervise electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, low-current systems, and control systems. Prepare electrical drawings, technical specifications, and project documentation. Coordinate with consultants, contractors, and other engineering disciplines to ensure efficient project delivery. Monitor project execution and ensure compliance with approved designs, codes, and standards. Conduct site inspections and provide technical support during installation, testing, and commissioning phases. Evaluate contractor submittals, shop drawings, material requests, and technical proposals. Identify and resolve technical issues and implement effective engineering solutions. Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental regulations. Prepare project progress reports and provide recommendations for improvements. Support project planning, budgeting, and cost-control activities. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering. Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering projects. Professional certification is an advantage. Strong knowledge of electrical design standards, regulations, and industry best practices. Proficiency in engineering software such as AutoCAD, ETAP, Revit, or equivalent. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively under pressure. Required Skills Electrical Design & Engineering Project Management Technical Review & Analysis Quality Control & Assurance Risk Assessment & Mitigation Teamwork & Coordination Problem Solving Communication & Reporting Time Management Knowledge of International Electrical Codes & Standards Experience 7+ years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within real estate development.

c1bccd4ff66fdaa4.description: About the Role The National Medical Care Company (Care) is seeking a Medical Reports Clerk to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves processing requests for medical reports for Riyadh Care Hospital, ensuring compliance with hospital requirements and maintaining high standards of patient service and confidentiality. Key Responsibilities Respond to patient inquiries concerning medical reports, translations, birth notifications, and sick leaves. Receive and process requests for medical reports, translations, birth notifications, and sick leaves. Issue medical reports, translations, birth notifications, and sick leaves in accordance with established policies and procedures. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely preparation and delivery of patient reports. Complete and verify demographic patient information accurately. Provide support and assistance to patients with inquiries or complaints. Maintain an organized filing system for efficient document retrieval. Contribute to departmental objectives and operational efficiency, including processing large volumes of work. Ensure all organizational and departmental quality standards are met. Uphold strict confidentiality regarding patient information. Participate in quality improvement programs as directed. Foster positive relationships with peers, staff, and visitors. Perform additional work-related duties as assigned by the Department Head/Manager or within the scope of Health Information Management (HIM). Reporting Structure This position reports directly to the Medical Reports Supervisor, HIM Director, or Department Head. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on supporting the operations of Riyadh Care Hospital within the National Medical Care Company (Care).

c1339b3bacba0c21.description: About Medtronic Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology, committed to alleviating pain, restoring health, and extending life. With 95,000 employees across more than 150 countries, the company focuses on developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of over 72 million patients annually. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the future of healthcare within a purpose-driven career. The Credit & Collections Function The Credit & Collections function supports Medtronic’s business operations in Saudi Arabia. This team is responsible for managing customer receivables, ensuring timely payments, resolving account discrepancies, and minimizing credit risk. The function collaborates closely with healthcare customers, Sales, Customer Care, and Finance departments to maintain accurate accounts and facilitate efficient collections processes. Role Summary: Credit Collections Clerk III As a Credit Collections Clerk III, you will manage a portfolio of customer accounts, focusing on the follow-up of overdue payments and the reconciliation of balances. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and offers a flexible work arrangement. The role requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field and involves working with various internal and external stakeholders to resolve payment barriers and maintain accurate account records, directly contributing to timely collections and reduced overdue receivables. Primary Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and follow up on overdue payments to support timely collections. Reconcile customer balances and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, payments, and credit notes. Coordinate with Sales, Customer Care, and Finance teams to resolve disputes and remove payment barriers. Monitor payment commitments and escalate overdue accounts or potential credit risks in line with company procedures. Maintain accurate records of collection activities, customer communications, and account status. Prepare accounts receivable updates, highlighting overdue balances, collection progress, and required follow-up actions. Required Experience 2-5 years of experience in credit collections or a related financial role. Work Location and Type This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a flexible work arrangement. The salary for this role is not disclosed.

c14343e60053f2ed.description: About the Role Khalid Ali Alturki & Sons Company (Alturki Holding) is seeking an Electrical Technician for Musanadah, their integrated Facilities Management services arm. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The Electrical Technician will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical systems across client facilities, ensuring their safety, reliability, and compliance. Key Responsibilities Perform planned preventive maintenance on various electrical systems, including distribution boards, Motor Control Centers (MCCs), control panels, lighting, and power circuits. Diagnose and resolve electrical faults efficiently using standard test equipment to minimize system downtime. Maintain and test standby generators, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) units, and battery systems to ensure continuous backup power readiness. Install and terminate cables, wiring, and fittings in adherence to the Saudi Building Code and IEC standards. Respond to work orders within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and accurately log activities and defects within the Computer-Aided Facilities Management (CAFM) system, while consistently following permit-to-work and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in electrical systems installation, maintenance, and repair, preferably within a facilities management context. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, focusing on providing integrated Facilities Management services to clients through Musanadah.

c157ae18c409e250.description: About the Role Magrabi Health is seeking an Ophthalmic Technician to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves supporting ophthalmologists and providing essential patient care within an eye care setting. The role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, as full training will be provided. Key Responsibilities Greet patients and accurately obtain their medical and ocular history. Perform preliminary tests, including visual acuity, color vision, depth perception, and visual field testing. Conduct tonometry and pupil dilation as directed by the ophthalmologist. Operate various ophthalmic equipment such as autorefractors, lensometers, slit lamps, and OCT machines. Perform and acquire ophthalmic ancillary diagnostic tests, including Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), corneal topography, fundus photography, and visual field analysis, ensuring image quality and proper documentation. Assist in refractive procedures, including pre- and post-operative assessments for LASIK, PRK, and other refractive surgeries; prepare patients, obtain measurements, and support the care team throughout the procedure workflow. Assist ophthalmologists during examinations and procedures. Maintain accurate patient records using EHR systems. Schedule appointments and support efficient patient flow within the clinic. Sanitize, calibrate, and troubleshoot clinical equipment on a regular basis. Coordinate with ophthalmologists regarding patients undergoing refractive procedures. Qualifications and Requirements Diploma of Optometry/Optics or an equivalent qualification. Valid Saudi MOH license as an optometry/optics technician. No prior clinical experience is necessary; full training will be provided. Strong interest in ophthalmology and eye care, with an eagerness to learn in a surgical center environment. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly and compassionately with patients. High attention to detail and the ability to follow clinical protocols accurately. Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-volume surgical setting. Basic computer literacy and willingness to learn EHR/EMR software. Professional demeanor, reliability, and a strong team-oriented attitude. Ability to stand for extended periods and assist with patient positioning as needed. Work Location This position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with potential opportunities in Jeddah. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c18fc7bd094c45fb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سعيد بن سعد بن بخروش الغامدي للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ ومتابعة أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني التمديدات الكهربائية مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة الأنظمة الكهربائية. تشمل هذه المسؤوليات دراسة المخططات، تقدير المواد، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال. دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات وتأمين التجهيزات ومطابقة مواصفاتها. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتشغيل دارات التمديدات. فحص التمديدات الكهربائية، بما في ذلك فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات اللازمة لمعالجتها. متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية للتمديدات الكهربائية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك أساساً قوياً في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية، مع التركيز على التطبيق العملي والفهم الفني. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأجهزة التمديدات الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التمديدات الكهربائية ضمن فريق شركة سعيد بن سعد بن بخروش الغامدي للمقاولات في منطقة الباحة، في بيئة عمل تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الباحة، وتقدم فرصة للمرشحين الجدد أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة لتطوير مهاراتهم في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

c1cb32290f4b4639.description: About Almarai Company Founded in 1977, Almarai Company is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and the largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai is the number one FMCG Brand in MENA and a market leader across its categories in the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. With over five decades of growth, Almarai has provided nutritious products under more than 20 brands, including Almarai, L’usine, and ALYOUM. The company employs over 43,000 professionals across its operations. The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager Almarai is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to join its team in Makkah, with operations spanning Rabigh and Makkah. This full-time role is critical for maintaining company assets and ensuring operational availability across all departments. The Senior Engineering Manager will be responsible for implementing and overseeing a total preventative maintenance system to meet business requirements and standards. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain a total preventative maintenance system to ensure complete operational availability for all departments. Comply with agreed standards, budget, and provisions set by the business. Meet management performance targets established by the business. Ensure all plant and equipment are maintained in optimal condition at all times, adhering to standards and cost controls. Provide adequate skills, labor, and guidance across all departments to meet business operational needs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in engineering management. Proven ability to implement and manage preventative maintenance systems. Strong understanding of operational standards, budgeting, and performance target achievement. Experience in ensuring optimal condition of plant and equipment. Demonstrated capability in managing and developing technical teams. Benefits Almarai offers a competitive package for this role. Benefits include generous leave, medical coverage, a discretionary bonus, and opportunities for training and development. Location This position is based in the Makkah region, covering operations in Rabigh and Makkah.

c1f6715c86fedea5.description: About the Role The Insurance Authority in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an Expert of Data Quality & Monitoring. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of data across the Authority's systems. The position involves establishing robust data quality validation frameworks, monitoring data integrity, and leading the development of reference data and metadata systems. Role Purpose and Impact This role plays a significant part in supporting regulatory compliance, business continuity, and the operational effectiveness of the Insurance Data Hub. The Expert of Data Quality & Monitoring will ensure that all data-related procedural and legislative requirements are met, contributing to high-quality and cost-effective results. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement automated data validation processes to identify and prevent data errors, inconsistencies, and missing records. Define and monitor data quality metrics, thresholds, and KPIs through dashboards and reports. Collaborate with Data Engineering & Storage teams to resolve data integrity issues at the storage level. Escalate persistent or high-risk data quality issues to Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) and relevant business units, especially when regulatory reporting is impacted. Establish real-time monitoring systems to detect data anomalies, unauthorized changes, and discrepancies, implementing alerting mechanisms for critical data quality breaches. Coordinate with IT and analytics functions to ensure clean, verified datasets are available for operational and strategic use. Contribute to crisis management efforts by validating datasets and facilitating rollbacks to trusted data sources when needed. Identify and document root causes of recurring data quality issues affecting reporting or supervisory accuracy. Align data quality policies and practices with frameworks defined by the Data Governance Office. Support audit readiness and regulatory compliance by maintaining validated datasets and documentation. Maintain up-to-date documentation of data validation rules, historical issues, quality thresholds, and resolution actions. Reference and Master Data Management Lead the development and implementation of a strategic approach to reference and master data management. Define and maintain standards, governance policies, and lifecycle procedures for key data domains. Ensure the integration of reference and master data across systems, including the Insurance Data Hub. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to harmonize and institutionalize RMD practices. Metadata and Data Cataloging Design and execute metadata frameworks to document, organize, and classify data assets within the Insurance Data Hub. Build and maintain a comprehensive data catalog that improves data discoverability, transparency, and reuse. Work with technical and business teams to ensure metadata remains up-to-date and aligned with evolving data assets and systems. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in data quality, data monitoring, or related fields.

c10776fa276b1d94.description: Job description Company Description Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF). Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene. Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector. Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. c1c9d4cf11f56ce7.description: Job Purpose The SAP FI-CO Consultant is responsible for implementing, configuring, maintaining, and optimizing SAP Financial Accounting (FI) and Controlling (CO) modules to support the company's financial operations, cost management, budgeting, and reporting requirements. c14a3d7746f32094.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخماسية العالمية للتطوير العقاري عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري والفني لرئيس قسم التطوير وفريق العمل، والمساهمة في متابعة مشاريع التطوير العقاري. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الإداري والفني لرئيس قسم التطوير وفريق العمل، والمساهمة في متابعة أعمال ومشاريع التطوير العقاري. إعداد التقارير الدورية والعروض التقديمية والملخصات التنفيذية، وتجميع وتحليل بيانات المشاريع وتنسيقها. إعداد الخطابات الرسمية والمراسلات البريدية ومتابعة المعاملات والطلبات مع الإدارات الداخلية والجهات الخارجية. تنسيق الاجتماعات وإعداد محاضرها ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات والتوصيات. التنسيق وتمثيل القسم لدى الجهات الحكومية والتنظيمية ومقدمي الخدمات والمطورين الرئيسيين والاستشاريين، وفق التكليف والصلاحيات المعتمدة، ومتابعة الإجراءات والاعتمادات المتعلقة بالمشاريع. متابعة مستجدات السوق العقاري في المملكة العربية السعودية، والاطلاع على التقارير الدورية والمؤشرات العقارية الصادرة عن الجهات الرسمية والمتخصصة. جمع وتحليل المعلومات المتعلقة بالمشاريع المنافسة والأسعار والعرض والطلب والفرص الاستثمارية. المساهمة في مراجعة المخططات والمستندات المعمارية وإعداد الدراسات الأولية وتحديث بيانات المشاريع وجداول المتابعة، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية والاستشاريين والمقاولين. تنظيم وأرشفة مستندات القسم وتحديث سجلات المهام والمعاملات. تنفيذ المهام الأخرى ذات الصلة وفق توجيهات رئيس القسم، مع الالتزام بسياسات الشركة والمحافظة على سرية المعلومات ودقة التقارير والمراسلات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري بدوام كامل ضمن فريق التطوير العقاري في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ويقدم الدعم المباشر لرئيس القسم. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن.

c1ba09421009b073.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for Customer Experience (CX) Intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
